records.jp: ……やってくれたわね
records.en_original: ...Now you've done it.
records.en_auxiliary: ...Now you've done it.
records.en: ...Now you've done it.

records.jp: うん。麻央、疑ってごめん。<CR>だけど、やっぱり一人では行かせられないよ
records.en_original: Yeah. I'm sorry I doubted you, Mao. But I still won't let you go alone.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah. I'm sorry I doubted you, Mao. But I still won't let you go alone.
records.en: Yeah. I'm sorry I doubted you, Mao. But I still won't let you go alone.

records.jp: 私も、実行委員だから！
records.en_original: I'm a committee member, too!
records.en_auxiliary: I'm a committee member, too!
records.en: I'm a committee member, too!

records.jp: 前から思ってたけど、あなた、なかなか強引なとこあるわよ
records.en_original: I was just thinking that you've got a pushy side to you.
records.en_auxiliary: I was just thinking that sometimes you can be a bit forceful.
records.en: I was just thinking that you've got a pushy side to you.

records.jp: そう？
records.en_original: Really?
records.en_auxiliary: Really?
records.en: Really?

records.jp: 仕方ないわね……。いいわ。<CR>じゃあここに電話してちょうだい
records.en_original: Well, it's not like I'm going to be able to shake you... Fine. Call these numbers.
records.en_auxiliary: Well, I guess you're here now. Fine. Call these numbers.
records.en: Well, it's not like I'm going to be able to shake you... Fine. Call these numbers.

records.jp: なにこれ？　何のリスト？
records.en_original: What's this? Some sort of list?
records.en_auxiliary: What's this? Some sort of list?
records.en: What's this? Some sort of list?

records.jp: ＯＧの人がやってるお店のリストよ
records.en_original: It's a list of stores run by alumni.
records.en_auxiliary: It's a list of stores run by alumni.
records.en: It's a list of stores run by alumni.

records.jp: いいけど、何を言えばいいの？
records.en_original: That's fine, but what should I say?
records.en_auxiliary: That's fine, but what should I say?
records.en: That's fine, but what should I say?

records.jp: それはね――
records.en_original: Well...
records.en_auxiliary: Well...
records.en: Well...

records.jp: 失礼します
records.en_original: Excuse us.
records.en_auxiliary: Excuse us.
records.en: Excuse us.

records.jp: あら？　早かったわね。もう調整済んだの
records.en_original: Hm? That was fast. Have you already made your adjustments?
records.en_auxiliary: Hm? That was fast. Have you already made your adjustments?
records.en: Hm? That was fast. Have you already made your adjustments?

records.jp: はい。よろしくお願いします
records.en_original: We have. Please look it over.
records.en_auxiliary: We have. Please, look it over.
records.en: We have. Please look it over.

records.jp: すごい！　ずいぶん安くなったのね
records.en_original: Amazing! It's so much less expensive!
records.en_auxiliary: Amazing! It's so much less expensive!
records.en: Amazing! It's so much less expensive!

records.jp: ええ。頑張っちゃいました
records.en_original: Yeah, we worked hard to make it happen.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah, we worked hard to make it happen.
records.en: Yeah, we worked hard to make it happen.

records.jp: ……すごいわ。一体何を削ったの？
records.en_original: ...It's unbelievable. What did you cut?
records.en_auxiliary: This is unbelievable. What did you cut?
records.en: ...It's unbelievable. What did you cut?

records.jp: 何も？
records.en_original: Nothing.
records.en_auxiliary: Nothing.
records.en: Nothing.

records.jp: え？
records.en_original: Huh?
records.en_auxiliary: Huh?
records.en: Huh?

records.jp: これは……どういうこと？
records.en_original: What's...the meaning of this?
records.en_auxiliary: What's... the meaning of this?
records.en: What's...the meaning of this?

records.jp: どう、とは？
records.en_original: What do you mean?
records.en_auxiliary: What do you mean?
records.en: What do you mean?

records.jp: 何この予算表！　何も変わってないのに、<CR>金額だけが書き換えられてる部分があるわよ
records.en_original: What's this budget sheet!? None of the items changed, but you've rewritten prices everywhere.
records.en_auxiliary: What's this budget sheet?! None of the items changed, but you've rewritten prices everywhere.
records.en: What's this budget sheet!? None of the items changed, but you've rewritten prices everywhere.

records.jp: ええ。ですから、購入先を変えたんです
records.en_original: Yeah. We're buying things from different places.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah. We're buying things from different places.
records.en: Yeah. We're buying things from different places.

records.jp: 以前は生徒会からいただいた価格表を参考にしてたんですけど、<CR>もっと安くできました
records.en_original: We used the price list given to us by the student council as reference before, but we managed to make it cheaper.
records.en_auxiliary: We used the price list given to us by the student council as reference before, but we managed to make it cheaper.
records.en: We used the price list given to us by the student council as reference before, but we managed to make it cheaper.

records.jp: でも、それにしても安すぎない……？<CR>これじゃあ、ほぼ原価と同じ位の額なんじゃ
records.en_original: But isn't this too cheap...? It looks like you'd be buying most of these things at cost.
records.en_auxiliary: But isn't this impossibly cheap? It looks like you'd be buying most of these things at cost.
records.en: But isn't this too cheap...? It looks like you'd be buying most of these things at cost.

records.jp: ＯＧの方にお願いしたんです。<CR>事情を説明したら、よくしてくれました
records.en_original: We asked alumni to help out. After explaining the situation, they gave us some really good deals.
records.en_auxiliary: We asked alumni to help out. After explaining the situation, they gave us some really good deals.
records.en: We asked alumni to help out. After explaining the situation, they gave us some really good deals.

records.jp: 新しく駅前にできた雑貨屋さんあるじゃないですか？<CR>ご存知ありません？
records.en_original: Particularly that new general store that opened near the station. Are you familiar with it?
records.en_auxiliary: Particularly that new general store that opened near the station. Are you familiar with it?
records.en: Particularly that new general store that opened near the station. Are you familiar with it?

records.jp: あ！　あのオシャレなお店？　そうだったの
records.en_original: Ah! That really stylish shop? So that's where you went.
records.en_auxiliary: Ah! That really stylish shop? So that's where you went.
records.en: Ah! That really stylish shop? So that's where you went.

records.jp: もしかしたら、先輩たちもお願いすれば、<CR>もっとコスト削減できるかもしれませんよ？
records.en_original: If you asked them, they might help you shave costs as well.
records.en_auxiliary: If you asked them, they might help you shave costs, as well.
records.en: If you asked them, they might help you shave costs as well.

records.jp: そう、ね……。教えてくれてありがとう
records.en_original: I see... Thank you for letting us know.
records.en_auxiliary: I see. Thank you for letting us know.
records.en: I see... Thank you for letting us know.

records.jp: いえいえ。それで、予算表ですけど、問題ありませんよね？<CR>他の学年よりかなり抑えられてますし
records.en_original: No problem. Anyway, are there any issues with the budget sheet? It should be lower than the other classes.
records.en_auxiliary: No problem. Anyway, are there any issues with the budget sheet? It should be lower than the other classes.
records.en: No problem. Anyway, are there any issues with the budget sheet? It should be lower than the other classes.

records.jp: ……ええ
records.en_original: ...None.
records.en_auxiliary: ...None.
records.en: ...None.

records.jp: 失礼します
records.en_original: Then excuse us.
records.en_auxiliary: Then, excuse us.
records.en: Then excuse us.

records.jp: それじゃあ白井さん、戻りましょう
records.en_original: Let's get back, Shirai.
records.en_auxiliary: Let's get back, Shirai.
records.en: Let's get back, Shirai-san.

records.jp: うん！
records.en_original: Yeah!
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah!
records.en: Yeah!

records.jp: やったね！　まさかＯＧの人にお願いするなんて、<CR>考えもしなかったよ
records.en_original: We did it! I never even thought about asking alumni to help out.
records.en_auxiliary: We did it! I never even thought about asking alumni to help out.
records.en: We did it! I never even thought about asking alumni to help out.

records.jp: 自分たちの時より予算が減ってる情報は知ってるはずでしょ？
records.en_original: They already know that our festival budget is lower than theirs when they were in school.
records.en_auxiliary: They already know that our festival budget is lower than theirs when they were in school.
records.en: They already know that our festival budget is lower than theirs when they were in school.

records.jp: きっと自分たちより厳しい状況を不憫に思って<CR>協力してくれると思ったの
records.en_original: I assumed they'd sympathize with our situation and want to help.
records.en_auxiliary: I assumed they'd sympathize with our situation and want to help.
records.en: I assumed they'd sympathize with our situation and want to help.

records.jp: 全く、手間を掛けさせてくれたわ……
records.en_original: Ugh. I hate doing more work than I need to.
records.en_auxiliary: Ugh. I hate doing more work than I need to.
records.en: Ugh. I hate doing more work than I need to.

records.jp: ホント、よかったよ！
records.en_original: It really is great!
records.en_auxiliary: That really is brilliant!
records.en: It really is great!

records.jp: けど、まだよくわかってないんだけど、<CR>結局なんで会長達、あんなに動揺してたんだろう？
records.en_original: But I still don't understand. Why did the student council look so shaken?
records.en_auxiliary: But I still don't understand. Why did the student council look so shaken?
records.en: But I still don't understand. Why did the student council look so shaken?

records.jp: そもそも、どうして私達の予算表が通らなかったのかわかってる？
records.en_original: Do you know why our budget didn't pass in the first place?
records.en_auxiliary: Do you know why our budget didn't pass in the first place?
records.en: Do you know why our budget didn't pass in the first place?

records.jp: え、それって上級生より高かったからじゃ
records.en_original: Huh? Wasn't it because it was higher than other classes?
records.en_auxiliary: Huh? Wasn't it because it was higher than other classes?
records.en: Huh? Wasn't it because it was higher than other classes?

records.jp: でも、２年も予算ギリギリだったし、<CR>３年に至っては予算オーバーしてたでしょ？
records.en_original: Nope. The second years were barely within budget, while the third years were actually over. Remember?
records.en_auxiliary: Nope. The second years were barely within budget, while the third years were actually over. Remember?
records.en: Nope. The second years were barely within budget, while the third years were actually over. Remember?

records.jp: そうなんだよねー……。もしかして、嫌がらせ、とか？<CR>でもそんなことして先生にバレたら怒られちゃうし……
records.en_original: That's right... Were they just trying to harass us? The teachers wouldn't stand for that if they found out...
records.en_auxiliary: That's right. Were they just trying to harass us? The teachers wouldn't stand for that if they found out.
records.en: That's right... Were they just trying to harass us? The teachers wouldn't stand for that if they found out...

records.jp: 答えは簡単でしょ？　あの人達、１年の予算表に<CR>自分たち３年の分を混ぜ込もうとしてたのよ
records.en_original: The answer's simple. They were trying to use part of the first year class's budget for their own third year budget.
records.en_auxiliary: The answer's simple. They were trying to use part of the first year class's budget for their own third year budget.
records.en: The answer's simple. They were trying to use part of the first year class's budget for their own third year budget.

records.jp: ええ！？
records.en_original: What!?
records.en_auxiliary: What?!
records.en: What!?

records.jp: そうすれば、総額としては変わらないし、発注の管理をするのは<CR>あくまで生徒会だもの。別にバレないでしょ？
records.en_original: That wouldn't change the total cost, and since the student council places their own orders. Nobody would find out.
records.en_auxiliary: That wouldn't change the total cost, and since the student council places their own orders, nobody would find out.
records.en: That wouldn't change the total cost, and since the student council places their own orders. Nobody would find out.

records.jp: それなら辻褄が合うでしょ？　そもそも予算をカットした側の<CR>教師陣が、都合つけてくれるわけないもの
records.en_original: It all fits together. The teachers were the ones who cut the budget in first place, they wouldn't let them go over.
records.en_auxiliary: It all fits together. The teachers were the ones who cut the budget in the first place. They wouldn't let them go over.
records.en: It all fits together. The teachers were the ones who cut the budget in first place, they wouldn't let them go over.

records.jp: 言われてみれば……
records.en_original: Now that you mention it...
records.en_auxiliary: Now that you mention it...
records.en: Now that you mention it...

records.jp: だから安くしてくれるお店を探したのよ。<CR>そうしたら２、３年の予算も安くできるし、調整ができるでしょ
records.en_original: So I looked for stores that would give us good deals. That balanced the other budgets and solved the problem.
records.en_auxiliary: So I looked for stores that would give us good deals. That balanced the other budgets and solved the problem.
records.en: So I looked for stores that would give us good deals. That balanced the other budgets and solved the problem.

records.jp: そっか…でも、ひどい話だね！
records.en_original: I see... But the problem's still a problem!
records.en_auxiliary: I see. But the problem's still a problem!
records.en: I see... But the problem's still a problem!

records.jp: だから言ったでしょ。みんな自分の事しか考えてないのよ
records.en_original: That's why I told you. People only think about themselves.
records.en_auxiliary: That's why I told you that people only think about themselves.
records.en: That's why I told you. People only think about themselves.

records.jp: う……でも、ちょっと意外だったよ
records.en_original: Ugh... This did come as a surprise, though.
records.en_auxiliary: Ugh... This did come as a surprise, though.
records.en: Ugh... This did come as a surprise, though.

records.jp: 何がよ？
records.en_original: What did?
records.en_auxiliary: What did?
records.en: What did?

records.jp: いや、麻央だったらその事実を突きつけて、<CR>予算を承認させてもおかしくないと思ったからさ
records.en_original: I thought you would have dug up the truth, stuck it in their faces, and forced them to approve your budget.
records.en_auxiliary: I thought you would have dug up the truth, stuck it in their faces, and forced them to approve your budget.
records.en: I thought you would have dug up the truth, stuck it in their faces, and forced them to approve your budget.

records.jp: そうしたら後々にしこりが残るでしょ？<CR>逆恨みされても面倒だし、全員が満足するのが一番よ
records.en_original: That would only lead to bad blood. Having people resent you is annoying. The best solutions satisfy everyone.
records.en_auxiliary: That would only lead to bad blood. Having people resent you is annoying. The best solutions satisfy everyone.
records.en: That would only lead to bad blood. Having people resent you is annoying. The best solutions satisfy everyone.

records.jp: それが後々の利に繋がるの
records.en_original: And usually lead to future benefits, too...
records.en_auxiliary: And usually lead to future benefits, too.
records.en: And usually lead to future benefits, too...

records.jp: なるほど…
records.en_original: I see...
records.en_auxiliary: That's clever.
records.en: I see...

records.jp: (麻央って、ただ相手を屈服させようとしてるわけじゃないんだ）
records.en_original: (So Mao isn't just trying to get others to submit to her.)
records.en_auxiliary: (So Mao isn't simply trying to get others to submit to her.)
records.en: (So Mao isn't just trying to get others to submit to her.)

records.jp: (麻央なりに、傷つく人を減らそうとしてるのかもな)
records.en_original: (She's trying to reduce the number of people who end up hurt, in her own way.)
records.en_auxiliary: (She's trying to reduce the number of people who end up hurt in her own way.)
records.en: (She's trying to reduce the number of people who end up hurt, in her own way.)
